title: Editor E6 slice: the touch gesture model and a layer list on the canvas
detail:
Split from PROG-E6 on 2026-11-14. Adds the pure gesture model (lib/builder/gesture.ts: a long-press state machine with a hold delay and a drift slop, a row hit-test, reorder, and the Alt+Arrow keyboard twin) and a layer list (components/builder/canvas/layer-list.tsx) mounted on the staff, EDITOR_CANVAS-gated /pages/canvas over a local demo section order. Three paths reorder a section: press-and-hold then drag, Alt+Arrow/Home/End, and Up/Down buttons that need no gesture. 44px targets, no hover, a polite live region announces each move. Dark. Unit tests cover the model and the list markup.

VERIFIED: pure model tests, SSR markup tests, lint, tokens. NOT VERIFIED: any real-device touch (pointer events are untested in jsdom, scroll-vs-drag arbitration, touch-action behaviour on iOS Safari). The order is local and not saved; it is not yet wired to a real document, the page editor, or the website editor.

Still on PROG-E6: spacing handles, drag from the canvas itself, the nested layer tree, a presets-first inserter on the canvas, and the E6 gate (the full authoring path completes on a phone), a device test.

verify.note: Fails on main: no gesture model and no layer list. Passes once the pure model, the layer list with its three reorder paths, and the dark canvas mount exist with tests.
